input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Base Terms impose no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall charge, or volume cap on Customer. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "volume" return nothing relevant: the only "volume" reference is § 11.5 Capacity Planning, which merely makes Customer responsible for forecasting and requesting its own capacity, not for buying committed capacity. Under § 4.1 Charges are payable only as specified in the Order Forms/Service Option Attachments (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), i.e. for ordered or actually used Services, which meets the preferred position. Customer also retains a monthly termination-for-convenience right on one month's notice under § 3.4, so no multi-year lock-in arises from the Base Terms. Noted for diligence only (not a deviation under this rule): § 3.4(b) contemplates "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — those attachments should be checked for any committed-term or shortfall economics, and termination-charge exposure is addressed under the termination rule rather than double-flagged here. § 14.11 (no resale) is a use restriction, not a volume restriction.
